name: Alpha
source:
Your new fraternity isn't just a family, it's a pack of wolves. Guided by your charismatic alpha, you must awaken the beast within… or die trying.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Alpha]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
你的新兄弟会不仅仅是一个家庭，而且是一群狼。在你魅力非凡的阿尔法的指引下，你必须唤醒内心的野兽……否则就会死去。

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Alpha]Choices Wikia[/url]]
